'''MaxSec Operations Access''' was an access road from the [[High Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] to the [[Maximum Security Section]], linking the [[Secure Vaults]] region with the [[Maximum Security Ops Center]].
